8. Commanding Weave: Whenever a creature gets a 5 or less on its save against your Iron Lattice, you may also push it up to 20'.
9. Anchor of Command: Whenever you push a creature with your Commanding Weave, you may instead teleport the target to any unoccupied space within 60' of it.

10. Master Web: As a free action, you can create a 60' radius web on the ground centred on you that lasts 24 hours. While inside the web, you and allies halve the distance of any pushes against you, and the entire area counts as your Webbed Ground for foes.
1. Steady Mind: Whenever you would be charmed or taunted, make a save, ignoring the condition on a success.
2. Moral Anchor: Whenever you finish a long rest affected by a behaviour-modifying effect, its effects are suppressed until your next long rest.
3. Act of Abstinence: Once per long rest, you can spend a minute reflecting on your values to remove a behaviour-modifying effect from you.
4. Clear Conscience: Whenever you would be frightened, make a save, ignoring the condition on a success.
5. Hardened Habit: Whenever you are targeted by a will attack, you can choose to reroll the attack roll once.
6. Shielded Reputation: You have advantage on Charisma checks made to refute slander or manipulation that would lead others to distrust you because of rumours of moral failing.
7. Purified Resolve: Once per long rest, when you resist a charm or taunt with your Steady Mind, recover HP equal to your level.
8. Fortified Temper: Whenever your Purified Resolve heals you, you also end the charmed or taunted condition on an ally within 30'.
9. Aegis of Principle: You are immune to the charmed and taunted conditions (your Purified Resolve still triggers when an effect would attempt to charm or taunt you).
10. Transcendent Temperance: Whenever a creature would attempt to charm or taunt you, you gain 50% resistance to psychic damage for 1 minute.

1. Scintillant Chip: Once per short rest, on hit, you can cause a small burst of heat and light that makes the attack deal 1 additional fire damage and ignites any flammable object the target is carrying. While the target holds the burning object, they suffer 1 ongoing fire harm, but may drop them immediately when they first ignite.
2. Kinetic Spark: Whenever your Scintillant Chip triggers, you can can also push the target 5' away from you.
3. Ember Nudge: On major success, you cause a tiny explosive pop centred on the target, causing 1 fire harm to the target and all foes adjacent to it.
4. Hotter Embers: The explosion radius of your Ember Nudge increases to 10' and the fire harm increases to 2.

5. Flashburst Conduit: Once per short rest, you can replace your Ember Nudge's explosion with increasing the attack's damage by 2d6 fire damage, and if the triggering attack scored a critical success, the target is also blinded for 1 round.
6. Charged Shrapnel: Whenever you use your Flashburst Conduit, the target and foes within 10' of it also suffer 1d6 fire harm.

7. Volatile Chamber: Once per long rest, on hit, you can trigger a large explosion. The attack deals 4d6 additional fire damage and all other foes within 15' of the target suffer 1d10 fire harm and are pushed 5' away from the target.
8. Stabilised Core: You can now use your Volatile Chamber once per short rest, its attack damage bonus increases to 5d6, and its fire harm increases to 1d12.

9. Cataclysmic Pattern: All fire damage or harm inflicted by this glyph path is increased by 1 or 1 die size (for flat or die-based amounts, respectively) for every 2 levels you are beyond level 5. Additionally, any pushes caused by this glyph path are increased by 5'.

10. Supernova Seal: Your Volatile Chamber's explosion radius increases to 30', its attack damage bonus increases to 6d6, its fire harm increases to 3d4, and affected creatures must make a save, becoming debilitated for 1 round on a fail.

1. Flicker of Warmth: You gain 50% resistance to cold damage, shed 10' of dim light, and as a free action you can warm a non-magical that you can hold in one hand such that it is comfortably warm for 1 hour. This allows your entire party to ignore the penalties of cold weather on your journey activities.
2. Tongue of Embers: You can use the Control Flames cantrip at-will, and gain an expertise die in Charisma checks while interacting with fire elementals.
3. Ember Affinity: Whenever you deal fire damage, you add 1d6 fire damage to it. You can do this a number of times between long rests equal to your proficiency bonus.
4. Kindle Warmth: Your Flicker of Warmth now grants immunity to cold damage while you are not wearing heavy armour, and the dim light radius increases to 30'.

5. Cindersoul: You gain 50% resistance to fire damage. Additionally, whenever you take fire damage, you can convert half the amount taken into temporary HP to gain. You can do so a number of times between long rests equal to your proficiency bonus.
6. Deep Ember: Your Ember Affinity's damage bonus increases to 2d6, and it recharges on a short or long rest.

7. Avatar of Flame: Once per long rest, when you roll for initiative, you shapeshift into an avatar of sacred flame for the remainder of combat. In this form, you gain immunity to fire damage, you gain 40' of fly speed, your melee attacks deal 1d8 additional fire damage, and you project a 10' persistent zone that causes 1d6 fire harm to foes.
8. Phoenix Resilience: Your Cindersoul now grants immunity to fire damage. Additionally, once per long long rest when you would drop to 0 HP, you can instead remain at 1 HP.

9. Divine Ember Mantle: Your Flicker of Warmth now projects 30' of bright light before its 30' of dim. Additionally, you project a 10' persistent zone that causes 3d6 fire harm to foes, and you can cast Wall of Fire once per long rest. When you do so, all of its die sizes increase by 1.

10. Apotheosis of Flame: Your Divine Ember Mantle's fire harm increases to 6d6, and its Wall of Fire can now be cast once per short or long rest. Additionally, your Tongue of Embers' Control Flames has a range of 1 mile. Finally, you ignore the penalties of hot weather on your journey activities and are immune to environmental fire damage.

1. Tactile Nudge: On hit, you can impose one of the following effects on the target after the attack: push them 5' or force them to drop an object they are holding. You can do this a number of times between long rests equal to your proficiency bonus.

2. Redirected Throw: Whenever you or a creature within 30' of you throws an object, you can alter the object's trajectory such that its new target is up to 5' away from its original one. You don't need line of sight to the new target of the throw. Using this feature expends a use of your Tactile Nudge.
3. Sweeping Vector: Your Tactile Nudge's push distance increases to 10'.

4. True Aim: Your Redirected Throw can now be used on creatures up to 60' away from you, and the target redirection range increases to 10'. Additionally, it no longer requires expending a use of Tactile Nudge.

5. Kinetic Cushion: Whenever you or a creature within 60' of you would take physical damage or suffer bludgeoning harm, you can halve that amount. You can do this a number of times between long rests equal to your proficiency bonus.
6. Pendulum Grasp: Whenever you use your Kinetic Cushion, the target can make a save, completely nullifying the damage or harm on a success.

7. Vector Shift: Once per short rest, as a free action, you create a 15'-radius controllable directional field centred on a point within 120' of you, which lasts for 1 round. Whenever a creature within the field is attacked, you can grant the attack advantage. Once on each of your turns, you can shift a creature or object in the field up to 30' in a straight line. Whenever a creature within the field would take physical damage, you can delay up to 4 points of that damage (scales with your glyphic harm) until the end of the target's next turn, or as a free action on your turn you can release the stored force into a creature within 60' of you, causing force harm equal to half the damage stored.

8. Momentum Web: Whenever a creature within 120' of you would be forcibly moved, you can redirect up to 15' of that movement into a different straight-line direction of your choice. You may do this a number of times between long rests equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded up).

9. Resonant Reversal: Your Vector Shift's radius increases to 30', its duration increases to 1 minute, and its maximum forced movement increases to 60'. Additionally, it can now be used twice per short rest.

10. Gravity Remaster: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can rewrite gravity in one of the following ways in a 60'-radius sphere centred on a point within 300' of you, which lasts for 1 minute. 1. Gravity is reversed within the sphere; 2. Creatures of your choice can walk and stand on any surfaces within the sphere, regardless of gravity; 3. Ranged attacks are debilitated within the sphere.
1. Glimmer Sight: You can see through reflective surfaces, up to 5' beyond the surface. Additionally, you have advantage on Perception checks for noticing details in reflections.
2. Mirror Echo: Once per long rest, you can cast Mirror Image on yourself.
3. Mirror Step: Once per short rest, you can step into a reflective surface (regardless of surface size) and step out of another within your line of sight within 15'.

4. Reflective Shard: Once per long rest, when you make a damaging attack, you can have your reflection aid the attack to add 3d6 psychic damage. If the attack scores a major success, the target also gets disadvantage on attack rolls for 1 round.

5. Echoed Mirror: You can now use your Mirror Echo twice between long rests, and when you do so, once per casting at any point during the spell's duration, you can have one of your duplicates cause 1d6 force harm to an adjacent creature as a free action.

6. Reflection Guardian: Once per long rest, when you roll for initiative, you can summon a Reflection Guardian drawn from your own reflection. It appears in an unoccupied space within 30' of you and requires your concentration as a CR 1 minion that deals force damage. It lasts for the remainder of combat, or until it dies.
7. Shimmering Dominion: Your Mirror Step's range increases to 60' and you can now use it twice between rests.

8. Mirrorworld Passage: Once per long rest, you may enter the reflection plane for up to 1 minute as a free action. While in this plane, you can be seen by material plane creatures only in material plane reflections, and can move through solid objects and creatures as if they were difficult terrain. You can only see into the material plane through reflective surfaces, up to 120' beyond them. After the duration, or when you end it early as another free action, you reappear in the nearest unoccupied space in the material plane.
9. Polished Ward: While you have line of sight to an adjacent reflective surface, you have +1 armour.
10. True Twin: Your Reflection Guardian now lasts for 1 hour after being summoned, and it increases to CR 2.
1. Whisper of Affection: Whenever a creature within 10' of you would be frightened, it makes a save, ignoring the condition on a success.
2. Pulse of Trust: You gain an expertise die in Persuasion, which is a d6 if you are persuading a creature that considers you an ally.
3. Heartbeat Sense: You can passively sense the surface thoughts of all cratures within 30' of you, as per the Detect Thoughts spell.
4. Strengthened Affection: Your Whisper of Affection extends to 30', and allies who succeed on its save also gain temporary HP equal to your level.
5. Deepened Trust: Once per long rest, when you roll for Persuasion against a creature that is not hostile towards you, you may roll with advantage.
6. Command of Passion: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can force a creature within 60' of you to make a save, becoming charmed by you for 1 minute on a fail.

7. Bond of the Heart: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can form a bond with a willing creature that lasts until your next long rest. While bonded, you both gain +1 to all defences while within 30' of each other.
8. Sovereign of Hearts: You are immune to being charmed, and creatures charmed by you are instead dominated.

9. Strengthened Heart: You can now use your Bond of the Heart twice between long rests, allowing you to have 2 bonds at a time. Additionally, you and your bonded creatures can telepathically communicate while within 60' of each other.
10. Perfected Passion: You can now use your Command of Passion twice between long rests, and creatures that succeed on its save are frightened of you for 1 round.
1. Blurred Recall: Whenever you make a History or Insight check, you may roll with advantage, but must discard the higher roll if it exceeds 15.
2. Forgotten Truth: Attacks against you from Divination spells have disadvantage.
3. Selective Forgetting: Once per long rest, you can choose to lose one of your skill proficiencies and replace it with a new one. This lasts until you finish a long rest.
4. Deepened Selection: Your Selective Forgetting now allows you to replace up to two proficiencies at once.

5. Veil of Amnesia: Whenever a creature would succeed in using a Divination spell on you, they must first pass a DC 15 Magiscience check, or only receive vague, fragmented impressions rather than clear ones.
6. Strengthened Veil: Creatures automatically fail the Magiscience check from your Veil of Amnesia.

7. Memory Lock: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can touch a creature and force it to make a save. On a fail, you lock away its memory of a specific event, detail, or ability until the target's next long rest.
8. Expanded Lock: You can now either touch up to 2 creatures with your Memory Lock, or lock away up to 2 memories from a single creature.
9. Eternal Forgetting: You are immune to all forms of Divination, including non-spell sources such as the vision of omnipotent beings.
10. Absolute Forgetting: As a free action at-will, you may permanently remove one of your skill proficiencies, replacing it with a permanent +4 bonus to that skill's ability score.
1. Stonehide: Once per short rest, as a free action, you can gain 50% resistance to bludgeoning damage for 1 round.
2. Thunderstep: You gain 5' of Speed.
3. Greater Stonehide: Your Stonehide now grants physical resistance instead.
4. Greater Thunderstep: Your Thunderstep's Speed bonus increases to 10', and you ignore difficult terrain caused by rubble or stone.
5. Titan's Grip: The Grapple and Shove maneuvers don't impose disadvantage on your attacks against targets smaller than you.
6. Voice of the Colossus: You gain advantage on Intimidation checks and can cast the Thaumaturgy cantrip at-will.

7. Colossal Might: Once per long rest, when you roll for initiative, you can channel titanic power for the remainder of combat. During this time, you gain +2 weapon AB and damage, and your melee reach increases by 5'.
8. Earthshaker: Once per long rest, when you land from a height of 10+', all foes within 10' of you must make a save, being knocked prone on a fail.

9. Skybreaker: Once per long rest, you can imbue a thrown attack you make with titanic power, causing it to deal 4d8 additional thunder damage. You can throw a melee weapon for the purposes of this power even if it doesn't have the Thrown trait.
10. Worldstride: Once per long rest, you can cast Teleport for free.
1. Stage Presence: You gain advantage on Busk journey activity checks.
2. Encore: Once per long rest, you can reroll a Busk journey activity check.

3. Captivating Presence: As a free action, you can start performing for up to 1 minute. Choose up to 3 creatures within 30' who can perceive you. They must succeed on a save or be charmed until your performance ends.
4. Enhanced Presence: You gain an expertise die in Busk journey activity checks.
5. Resonant Emotion: While performing with your Captivating Presence, affected creatures also feel a strong emotion of your choice. This influences their mood.
6. Improved Encore: You can now use your Encore twice between long rests.
7. Command Performance: While performing with your Captivating Presence, affected creatures cannot make attacks. Your performance ends if any of them are hurt during your performance.
8. Improved Emotion: You can replace the charm effect of your Captivaitng Presence with frighten.
9. Grand Maestro: The range of your Captivating Presence increases to 60', and creatures charmed by it are friendly towards you.
10. Improved Performance: Creatures charmed by your Captivating Presence are also dominated.
1. Whisper of Memory: Once per long rest, you can add a +1 bonus to any ability check, after you roll it.
2. Faded Spark: Choose any cantrip. Once per long rest, you can cast that cantrip, governed by any ability.
3. Resonant Recall: Your Whisper of Memory now grants a +2 bonus and can be used twice between long rests.
4. Lingering Flame: You can now use your Faded Spark cantrip at-will, and once per long rest you can cast it as if it were 2 level tiers higher.
5. Fragment of Power: Choose any 1st-level spell. Once per long rest, you can cast that spell, governed by any ability.
6. Echoing Strength: Your Whisper of Memory now grants a +3 bonus and can be used thrice between long rests.

7. Awakening Surge: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can gain advantage on all attack rolls and saves, and any ability checks that you are proficient or have expertise dice in. This effect lasts for 1 minute.
8. Restored Flame: Your Your Faded Spark cantrip can now be cast as if you were 17th level once per combat, instead of its previous uptiering effect.
9. Legacy Unbound: Choose any 3rd-level spell. Once per long rest, you can cast that spell, governed by any ability.
10. Eternal Echo: You can use your Awakening Surge twice between long rests, and whenever you use it, you recover either half your missing exertion or your highest-level expended spell slot.

1. Spark of Alloy: Once per long rest, you can conjure a palm-sized lump (500g) of raw bronze. 100 of these (50kg) can be sold for 1gp. Alternatively, any weapon that deals damage with a metal component can be augmented by a blacksmith for 1gp and one of these bronze lumps, permanently increasing that weapon's base damage die size by 1 and granting it the Scaling (+1) trait.
2. Bronze-Touched Skin: You gain resistance to acid damage equal to your level.

3. Molten Memory: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can conjure a one-handed bronze weapon of any type that deals damage with a metal component. This weapon lasts until you next take a rest, and is identical to a regular version of the weapon type, except that it is augmented by your Spark of Alloy and attacks with it ignore resistance and immunity.
4. Echo of the Forge: Your Spark of Alloy augment now increases base damage die size by 2 and the trait added becomes Scaling (+2).
5. Alloy Ascendant: Your Spark of Alloy now conjures 10 times as much bronze (5kg).

6. Living Alloy: As a free action, you can animate 5kg of bronze into a small CR 1 construct minion (requires your concentration to maintain) that deals bludgeoning damage. It lasts until it dies or you take a rest.

7. Bronze Bastion: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can conjure a bronze shield. The shield lasts until you next take a long rest and behaves like a regular shield, but provides 1 additional armour.
8. Bronze Bulwark: Your Bronze Bastion shield now also grants immunity to ranged weapon damage.

9. Bronze Colossus: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can manifest a large CR 10 construct minion (requires your concentration to maintain) that deals bludgeoning damage. It lasts until it dies or you take a rest.
10. Eternal Alloy: Your Spark of Alloy augment now increases base damage die size by 3 and the trait added becomes Scaling (+3).
1. Graincall: As a free action, you can conjure sand at-will, at a rate of 2L per round.

2. Desert's Trinket: As a free action, you can shape sand into a small, fragile trinket that lasts for 1 hour before crumbling. You design how it looks, and it doesn't need to look like it is made of sand, though touching it reveals its true nature.
3. Glassborn: As a free action, you can fuse sand into crude glass objects, which are functional but fragile. They last for 24 hours before disappearing.
4. Sandshaper's Grip: As a free action, you can form sand into any item that could be found in an adventuring kit.
5. Glassborn Refined: Objects created by your Glassborn now last indefinitely, and are made of standardly-durable glass.

6. Duneform Sentinel: Once per long rest, when you roll for initiative, you can create a small CR 1/4 construct minion (requires your concentration to maintain) in a space adjacent to you. It lasts until it dies or the combat ends.
7. Glassheart Relic: As a free action, you can create flawless glass foci, which last until destroyed or they leave your party. While held in a single hand, the wielder gains +1 to spell AB.
8. Sandshaper's Bastion: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can form sand into a wall up to 10' long and high and up to 1' thick. They last for 1 hour and provide half cover.
9. Sandshaper's Dominion: As a free action, you can create permanent sand structures. They remain until destroyed.
10. Duneform Colossus: Your Duneform Sentinel is now Huge and has a CR of 7. Additionally, it lasts until it dies or you next take a long rest.
1. Flexed Form: Whenever you would become grappled, make a save, ignoring the condition on a success.
2. Controlled Breath: You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes, and you reduce incoming harm and damage from gases by 50%.
3. Muscle Memory: You gain an expertise die in one Strength or Dexterity skill of your choice.
4. Improved Control: You no longer need to breathe and are now completely unaffected by harmful gases.
5. Surge of Flesh: Once per long rest, when you roll for initiative, you may reshape your body for the remainder of combat. During this time, you gain your choice of +2 Fortitude or +2 Reflex.
6. Resilient Hide: You gain 1 armour while not wearing heavy armour.
7. Improved Flex: Fortitude attacks made against you have disadvantage.
8. Perfected Physique: You gain 50% resistance to bludgeoning damage.
9. Improved Hide: Your Resilient Hide's armour bonus increases to +2.
10. Transcendent Physique: You gain 50% resistance to physical damage and whenever you use your Surge of Flesh, you gain temporary HP equal to triple your level.

1. Bubble Breath: As a free action while underwater, you can create a small bubble of air that lasts for 1 minute. The bubble is large enough for a creature to breathe comfortably while holding it to their face (requires one hand to do so).
2. Bubble Bounce: Once per long rest, you can reduce the fall damage a creature within 60' of you would take by 1d6.
3. Improved Breath: Your Bubble Breath bubble is now large enough for a Medium creature to fit inside completely, allowing it to breathe normally for up to 10 minutes without any hands used.
4. Bubble Step: For a total of 10 minutes between long rests, you gain 20' of flying speed while you are within 10' of a water source.
5. Bubble Shield: Once per short rest, when you roll for initiative, you may surround yourself with a thin bubble for the remainder of combat. During this time, you have +1 armour.
6. Bubble Prison: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can conjure a bubble of water around a creature within 30' of you. The target must pass a save or be restrained for 1 minute.
7. Improved Shield: Your Bubble Shield now also grants 50% resistance to bludgeoning damage.
8. Improved Prison: Your Bubble Prison can now be used on two different creatures at once as part of the same use. Additionally, its duration increases to 10 minutes.

9. Bubble World: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can create a bubble of oxygenated water up to a 30' sphere centred on a point within 60' of you. It lasts for 1 hour. While inside, creatures can breathe and move as if underwater.
10. Improved Step: Your Bubble Step can now be used for a total of 1 hour between long rests, grants 40' of flying speed, and no longer requires proximity to water.
1. Spark of Merriment: Whenever an ally within 10' of you would become frightened, it makes a save, ignoring the condition on a success. A creature can only make this save once per long rest.
2. Echo of Laughter: Whenever a non-armour attack scores a minor success or worse against you, allies within 10' of you gain temporary HP equal to your level.
3. Toast of Triumph: Once per short rest, when you or an ally within 30' of you scores a critical success, the attacker regains HP equal to your level plus your proficiency bonus.
4. Greater Merriment: There is no longer a limit to how often a creature can benefit from your Spark of Merriment.

5. Dance of Delight: Once per long rest, when you roll for initiative, you may being a magical dance for the remainder of combat. During this time, allies within 30' of you gain advantage on armour and will attacks while you are within their line of sight.
6. Greater Laughter: Your Echo of Laughter now grants temporary HP equal to double your level.

7. Festival's Fortune: Once per long rest, when you complete a short rest, you and up to 5 allies who took the short rest with you regain either 3 spell slot levels or 3 exertion (chosen by each creature).
8. Greater Triumph: Whenever your Toast of Triumph triggers, you and all allies within 30' of you are healed instead of just the attacker.
9. Eternal Jubilee: You cannot be frightened or charmed, and whenever an ally within 30' of you would receive either of those conditions, it makes a save, ignoring the condition on a success.
10. Greater Delight: Your Dance of Delight now lasts for 10 minutes, grants allies immunity to being charmed, and now grants advantage with all attacks.
1. Whisper of Bloom: Creatures adjacent to you have disadvantage on Insight checks against your Deception checks.
2. Lingering Aroma: Your Whisper of Bloom's range increases to 10'.
3. Veil of Petals: Creatures charmed by you perceive harmless illusions, granting them a -1 penalty to all ability checks.
4. Fragrant Mirage: You can now choose for your Veil of Petals illusions to obscure small objects or create harmless illusory terrain features within a 10' cube around the charmed creature.
5. Dreaming Breath: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can exhale a cloud of pheromones in a 15' cone. Creatures in that area must make a save or be charmed by you for 1 minute.
6. Deep Bloom: Your Dreaming Breath's cone increases to 30' and affected creatures have disadvantage on attacks while charmed by it.
7. Perfume of Reverie: Whenever an ally within 10' of you would become frightened, it makes a save, ignoring the condition on a success.
8. Perfume of Ecstasy: Allies within your Perfume of Reverie range are now immune to being frightened.
9. Hallucinatory Dominion: Creatures charmed by you are also dominated.
10. Eternal Bloom: Once a creature is charmed by you, it remains so until it takes a long rest, unless it is hurt by you or your allies after the charm's original duration.
1. Planet's Endurance: You gain 50% resistance to environmental damage.
2. Planet's Vitality: Your maximum HP increases by 6.

3. Planet's Pull: Once per long rest, when you roll for initiative, you can manipulate gravity around you for the remainder of combat. During this time, foes within 10' of you treat the ground as difficult terrain and ranged weapon attacks passing through that area have disadvantage.
4. Greater Endurance: You are immune to the penalties of weather on your journey activities.
5. Greater Vitality: The HP bonus from your Planet's Vitality increases to 22.
6. Planet's Dominion: The first time a foe is within 10' of you while your Planet's Pull is active, you can force it to make a save, becoming restrained for the remainder of combat on a fail.
7. Planet's Insight: Your will increases by 1.
8. Supreme Endurance: You gain 50% resistance to physical damage.
9. Planet's Radiance: Allies within 30' of you gain +1 to all defences against spell attacks.
10. Supreme Vitality: The HP bonus from your Planet's Vitality increases to 56. Additionally, once per long rest, when you would drop to 0 HP, instead remain at 1 HP.
1. Kindred Spark: Whenever you finish a short rest alongside an ally, you gain temporary HP equal to your level.
2. Warmth of Company: Whenever you gain temporary HP from Kindred Spark, one ally of your choice who finished the rest with you gains the same temporary HP.
3. Shared Footing: While within 10' of an ally, you gain +1 reflex.
4. Echoed Momentum: While within 10' of an ally, you gain +1 to initiative rolls.

5. Heartlink: Once per long rest, when you roll for initiative, you can forge a magical bond between yourself and up to 2 willing creatures within 30' of you for the remainder of combat. During this time, whenever one linked creature takes damage, another linked creature of your choice gains 50% resistance to the next instance of damage it takes before the end of their next turn.
6. Strengthened Bonds: Creatures linked by your Heartlink also have +1 armour.
7. Fellowship's Resilience: Once per long rest, when you are hit by an attack, you can choose to downgrade it one success tier if an ally is in your line of sight.
8. Circle of Trust: Whenever an ally within 10' of you would be charmed or frightened, it makes a save, ignoring the condition on a success.

9. Soulbound Triumph: Whenever you or an ally within 30' of you scores a critical success or killing blow, you may choose up to 3 creatures within 30' of that creature. Each chosen creature gains temporary HP equal to your level plus your proficiency bonus and may immediately shift up to 10'.

10. Unbreakable Bond: Once per long rest, when you or an ally within 30' of you would be reduced to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP instead. When you do this, you and all allies within 30' of you gain 50% damage resistance until the end of your next turn.

1. Chitin Knuckles: Your hands develop hardened chitin plates, granting you a natural weapon that deals 1d4 + STR slashing damage. This natural weapon has the Angled (smaller), Deadly, Rapid, and Returning traits.
2. Grasping Spur Growth: Using the Grapple maneuver does not impose disadvantage on your Attack actions using your Chitin Knuckles.

3. Pincer Form: The base damage die of your Chitin Knuckles increases to 1d6. Additionally, when you attack a creature you are not grappling with them alongside the Grapple maneuver, the attack has advantage.
4. Crushing Pincer Strength: Your Chitin Knuckles attacks against targets grappled by you deal 1d6 additional bludgeoning damage.
5. Serrated Edges: Attacks with your Chitin Knuckles deal 1d6 additional slashing damage.
6. Rending Lock: While you are grappling a creature, your Chitin Knuckles attacks have +1 critical success range.
7. Adamantine Chitin: Attacks with your Chitin Knuckles ignore resistances.

8. Pincer Crush: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can cause 1d8 bludgeoning harm to a creature you are grappling and force it to make a save. On a fail, the target is restrained until the start of your next turn. This power's cooldown is recharged whenever you score a killing blow with your Chitin Knuckles.
9. Hardened Carapace Joints: You gain +1 AB with attacks made with your Chitin Knuckles, and their base damage die increases to 1d8. Additionally, they gain the Scaling (+1) trait.

10. Apex Predator Clamp: The restrain from your Pincer Crush now lasts as long as the grapple does, and while restraining a creature in that way, attacks with your Chitin Knuckles deal 2d6 additional slashing damage.
1. Spark of Sharing: As a free action, a creature within 30' of you gains +1 to the next ability check they make before the start of your next turn.
2. Echo of Aptitude: Whenever you use your Spark of Sharing, you can apply the bonus to the target's next save instead.
3. Gift of Momentum: Whenever you grant your Spark of Sharing to a creature, they also gain +5' of Speed until the start of your next turn.
4. Gift of Precision: Whenever you grant your Spark of Sharing to a creature, they also gain a +1 bonus to their next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

5. Mantle of Empowerment: Once per long rest, when you roll for initiative, choose up to 3 creatures within 30' of you to gain one of the following benefits (your choice for each target) for the remainder of combat: +1 armour, +10' of Speed, or advantage on the next save they make.
6. Mantle Expansion: Your Mantle of Empowerment now affects up to 5 creatures.
7. Radiant Delegation: Whenever you use a power that affects only yourself and doesn't require concentration, you may choose another creature within 30' of you to also gain that power's effects.
8. Delegation Mastery: Your Radiant Delegation can now duplicate effects that require concentration. You maintain concentration on both effects at the same time.
9. Apotheosis of the Many: Once per turn, when you apply a beneficial effect to an ally, you may choose another ally within 30' of you to receive the same benefit.
10. Benefactor Ascendant: Your Mantle of Empowerment now lasts indefinitely. You can change the bonus granted to each creature whenever you roll for initiative.
1. Cinder Mantle: While unarmoured, your base armour is 1. While armoured, you ignore the penalties of cold weather on your journey activities.
2. Ember Ward: Whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack, it suffers 1 fire harm.
3. Searing Rebuke: Your Ember Ward's fire harm increases to 1d4, and is also triggered by hits from ranged attacks from attackers within 30' of you.

4. Aegis of the Inferno: Once per long rest, when you roll for initiative, you can ignite a full suit of flame armour around yourself for the remainder of combat, immediately gaining temporary HP equal to your level plus your proficiency bonus. 5. Tempered Aegis: Your Aegis of the Inferno's temporary HP bonus increases to your level plus double your proficiency bonus, and its persistent zone harm increases to 1d4.
6. Flamebound Carapace: Your Cinder Mantle's unarmoured base armour increases to 2, and its armoured bonus also now grants 50% resistance to fire damage.
7. Inferno Reprisal: Your Ember Ward's fire harm increases to 2d8, and whenever it triggers, you may choose to also push the attacker 10' away from you.
8. Eternal Flameplate: You gain immunity to fire damage, gain 50% resistance to cold damage, and no longer need to breathe.
9. Pyroclastic Bulwark: You gain 50% resistance to physical damage, which becomes immunity while your Aegis of the Inferno is active.

10. Incandescent Ascendant: Your Aegis of the Inferno now lasts for 10 minutes, its persistent zone harm increases to 2d8, and once per activation of the feature, you can unleash a flare nova as a free action. When you do so, all foes within 20' of you suffer 5d4 fire harm.
1. Rippleflesh: You can hold your breath for 1 hour, you gain 50% resistance to cold damage, your jump distance increases by 5', and you can squeeze through spaces as if 1 size smaller.
2. Watery Grasp: When interacting with unattended objects or using the Grapple maneuver as an action, you gain +5' of reach. Additionally, grapples you initiate count as if you were 1 size larger.
3. Brineheart: You gain immunity to disease, 50% resistance to acid damage, and can breathe underwater.

4. Flowform Shift: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can shapeshift into a Small water form for 10 minutes. 5. Form Extension: Your Flowform Shift's duration increases to 30 minutes, and its swim speed becomes 30'.

6. Surge Step: Whenever you score a major success with a charged attack, you may push the target 10' away from you and knock it prone. You can do this a number of times between long rests equal to your proficiency bonus.
7. Form Mastery: Your Flowform Shift now grants immunity to bludgeoning damage, allows you to move through hostile spaces, and replaces all your movement with shifting.
8. Tidal Veil: You gain half cover against ranged weapon attacks and can walk on water as if it were solid ground.
9. Ocean's Avatar: You gain 40' of swim speed, 50% resistance to physical damage, and can communicate simple ideas to water elementals when you speak.

10. Maelstrom Ascendant: Your Flowform Shift is now Medium-sized, and it grants the following additional benefits: 30' of fly speed and hovering, the first time on each of your turns that you enter a foe's space it suffers 2d8 bludgeoning harm and must pass a save or become restrained for 1 round, and you can move through solid objects and structures as if they were difficult terrain but you cannot end your turn inside one.
1. Skinbound: Your armour cannot be reduced while you are unarmoured, and its base value is 1.
2. Sensory Web: You gain 5' of blindsight.
3. Elastic Form: You can move through spaces as small as 6 inches wide without squeezing while not holding any objects or wearing anything but clothes.
4. Dermal Grip: You gain climbing speed equal to your Speed so long as you are not holding anything.
5. Upgraded Web: Your Sensory Web's blindsight increases to 15'.

6. Living Mantle: Once per long rest, when you roll for initiative, you can unfurl your skin into a protective mantle for the remainder of combat. When you do so, you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus plus double your level. During this time, creatures that hit you with melee attacks suffer psychic harm equal to your proficiency bonus.
7. Skinshield: You gain 50% resistance to slashing damage.

8. Fleshflow: You can move through spaces as small as 1 inch wide without squeezing, even while equipped. Additionally, whenever you would become grappled or restrained, make a save, ignoring the condition on a success.
9. Upgraded Shield: Your Skinshield also grants 50% resistance to piercing damage.
10. Perfect Skinwoven: You gain immunity to slashing and piercing damage and weapon critical successs against you become major successs instead.
1. Seed of Balance: When you first gain this feature, choose to gain 50% resistance to either fire or cold damage.
2. Rooted Footing: You cannot be knocked prone by non-magical effects.
3. Cycle of Breath (weak): You can hold your breath for up to 30 minutes.
4. Balanced Metabolism: You reduce all journey gold costs by 1.
5. Predator's Precision: Once per turn, you may add a +2 bonus to an attack roll or a Stealth check.
6. Prey's Instinct: You gain a +2 bonus to your initiative.

7. Verdant Rebalance: Once per long rest, as a free action, you may release a pulse of natural equilibrium in a 20' radius, with one of the following effects of your choice: creatures of your choice regain 4d4 HP; creatures of your choice suffer 1d8 necrotic harm.
8. Improved Rebalance: Verdant Rebalance's radius increases to 30', its healing increases to 4d6, and its harm increases to 2d6.
9. Avatar of Cycles: Whenever you roll for initiative, choose a creature within 60' of you. For 1 roudn, it gains your choice of 50% vulnerability or 50% resistance to a damage type of your choice.
10. Nature's Fulcrum: You gain immunity to poison and disease, and once between long rests when you would drop to 0 HP, instead remain on 1.

1. Spiral Flexion: Whenever you would become grappled or restrained, make a save, ignoring the condition on a success. Additionally, you gain +5' of reach for the purposes of interacting with objects.
2. Torque Grip: You gain +1 to Finesse, and cannot have disadvantage on ability checks utilising your hands.
3. Revolving Stride: You gain +5' of Speed and ignore difficult terrain caused by rubble, undergrowth, or clutter.
4. Upgraded Flexion: Your Spiral Flexion's save now also works for the prone condition. Additionally, whenever you would be pushed, you may halve the distance you are pushed.
5. Gyroscopic Core: You are now immune to becoming prone or being pushed against your will.
6. Upgraded Grip: Your unarmed attacks deal 1d4 additional bludgeoning damage.

7. Cyclonic Unwind: Once per long rest, as a free action, you spin your entire body at impossible speed, creating a 10' radius swirl of kinetic pressure. Foes in this area suffer 1d4 bludgeoning harm and must make a save, being pushed 10' away from you on a fail.
8. Upgraded Stride: Your Revolving Stride's Speed bonus increases to 10', and once per short rest, you can take the Dash action as a bonus action.
9. Helical Anatomy: You gain 50% resistance to bludgeoning damage and can squeeze to fit through spaces as narrow as 3 inches wide.
10. Upgraded Core: Whenever you would be knocked prone or pushed against your will, you can instead reflect that ignored effect back onto its source, where possible.
1. Synaptic Sensitivity: You have advantage on Insight checks made to determine a creature's emotional state.
2. Neurostatic Dampening: Attacks attempting to sense your emotions or read your thoughts have disadvantage.
3. Theta Pulse Reading: As an action, you learn whether a creature within 30' of you is hostile, neutral, or friendly towards you.
4. Theta Pulse Refinement: Whenever you use your Theta Pulse Reading, you also learn the target's current dominant emotion.

5. Cerebral Lock: Once per short rest, as a free action, you can emit a focused brainwave towards a creature within 60'. It must make a save, becoming debilitated until the start of your next turn on a fail.
6. Lock Intensification: Creatures that pass their save against your Cerebral Lock are slowed until the start of your next turn.
7. Neural Interference: You have +1 to defences against attacks from creatures within 10' of you.
8. Neurocrown Overdrive: You gain 50% psychic resistance and creatures have disadvantage on their saves against your Cerebral Lock.
9. Interference Amplification: Your Neural Interference now grants +2 to defences and its range increases to 20'.
10. Mindwave Dominion: Whenever you would debilitate a creature with your Cerebral Lock, you may choose to dominate it for 1 round instead.
1. Particulate Sense: You instinctively detect suspensions, gels, foams, and emulsions within 30' of you and learn whether they are magical or hazardous.
2. Rheological Grip: Creatures of your choice within 10' of you treat non-solid environmental substances, such as mud, water, or fog, as difficult terrain.
3. Colloidal Dominion: As a free action, you can reshape, solidify, liquefy, or disperse suspensions, gels, foams, and emulsions within 60' of you.

4. Rheological Mastery: Your Rheological Grip now has a 15' range and affected creatures must make a save whenever they attempt to move through affected areas. On a fail, their Speed becomes 0 for the remainder of their turn.
5. Microstructure Stability: Whenever you would be pushed or knocked prone, make a save, ignoring the effect on a success.
6. Enhanced Sense: Your Particulate Sense's range increases to 60', and it now reveals precise qualities of the substance, including magical signatures and chemical details.
7. Colloidal Shield: As a free action, gain temporary HP equal to triple your proficiency bonus. You can do so a number of times between long rests equal to your proficiency bonus.

8. Colloid Construct: Once per long rest, as a free action, you can create a colloid construct, a CR 1/8 construct minion that requires your concentration to maintain. It lasts for 1 minute, or until it dies. Additionally, it can squeeze through spaces as narrow as 1 inch.
9. Reinforced Shield: Whenever you gain temporary HP from your Colloidal Shield, you gain your choice of 50% bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing resistance while you have that temporary HP.
10. Perfect Suspension: You gain 50% physical resistance, can move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing, and are immune to the grappled, restrained, and staggered conditions.

1. Arcane Residue Sense: You detect the presence of non-equipment magic within 10' of you. You can distinguish the location of each magical effect and differentiate between them, but nothing more about them.
2. Residue Absorption: Whenever you finish a short rest, you gain 1 Residue until you finish a long rest.
3. Matterweaver Bolt: As a free action, you can expend 1 Residue to fire a condensed mote of magical matter at a creature within 60' of you. The target suffers 2d4 force harm.
4. Bolt Stabilisation: Your Matterweaver Bolt now causes 3d4 force harm.
5. Arcane Coalescence: Your Residue Absorption now grants you 2 Residue.
6. Matterweaver Shield: Whenever you are about to take damage, you may expend 1 Residue to gain 11 temporary HP that lasts until your next turn.
7. Bolt Intensification: Your Matterweaver Bolt now causes 5d4 force harm, and its target is also pushed 5' away from you.
8. Matter Compression: Your Residue Absorption now grants you 3 Residue.

9. Arcane Singularity: Whenever you use your Matterweaver Bolt, you may expend 1 additional Residue to cause all creatures of your choice within 10' of the target to be pushed up to 5' towards the target.
10. Perfect Conduit: You now roll your Matterweaver Bolt's harm with advantage and are immune to force damage.

1. Whisper Ink: As a free action, you can impress faint markings onto any object or structure's surface within 10' of you. The markings can be no larger than a 15cm square, last for 1 hour, and are faint, like chalk.
2. Steady Script: Your Whisper Ink's range increases to 30'.
3. Mind Quill: As a free action, you can erase, move, reshape, or rewrite your Whisper Ink markings while within range of them.
4. Script Sense: You always know the exact location of any of your Whisper Ink markings within 1km. Additionally, you can see through them as if they were your own eyes, but only in greyscale.

5. Living Lines: As an action, you can animate one of your Whisper Ink markings within 60' of you to form a Tiny, weightless construct for 10 minutes. You can only have one at a time. 6. Upgraded Lines: Your Living Lines now last up to 1 hour, and can carry up to 9kg.

7. Psychic Engraving: Your Whisper Ink markings can now be etched into any non-magical object or structure's surface as though carved with a chisel. They are permanent unless erased with your Mind Quill.
8. Script-Ward: Whenever you create a Psychic Engraving, you may ward it. The first time a creature other than you touches or damages the warded marking it suffers 2d8 psychic harm.
9. Reality Ink: Once per long rest, you can cast the Glyph of Warding spell.
10. Upgraded Ink: Your Reality Ink is upcast to 5th level, and it becomes invisible to all creatures except those you designate.
1. Smallfolk Stature: You are one size smaller and gain advantage on checks to hide behind creatures at least one size larger than you.
2. Lucky Spark: Once per long rest, upon rolling a natural 1 on an attack, ability check, or save, you may reroll the die.
3. Nimble Step: Your Speed increases by 5' and opportunity attacks have disadvantage against you.
4. Improved Spark: You can now use your Lucky Spark twice between long rests.
5. Improved Step: Your Nimble Step now increases your Speed by 10' and you ignore difficult terrain.

6. Impossible Escape: Once per short rest, when you are hit by an attack, you may teleport up to 15' to an unoccupied space. If your new location breaks line of sight from the attacker, the attack critically fails.
7. Legendary Luck: You can now use your Lucky Spark to reroll any d20 roll, even after learning the result (but not the consequences) of the roll.
8. Hearth-bound Resilience: Your will increases by 1.
9. Uncanny Hearth-sense: You gain 50% resistance to environmental damage and advantage on initiative rolls.
10. Small but Unbreakable: You gain immunity to being frightened, cannot be moved against your will, and once per long rest when you would drop to 0 HP, you may remain on 1 HP instead.
1. Emberstone Skin: You gain fire resistance equal to your proficiency bonus, and can safely touch non-magically-heated objects up to 250 degrees.
2. Cinderstep: You ignore non-magical difficult terrain made of earth, sand, or stone. Additionally, your footsteps leave harmless glowing cinders that fade after 1 minute. This impacts your stealth.
3. Hardened Crust (weak): Your Emberstone Skin's resistance becomes double your proficiency bonus, and the safe heat increases to 650 degrees.
4. Magma Pulse: Whenever you deal bludgeoning damage, you deal 1d4 additional fire damage.
5. Obsidian Shards: When hit by a melee attack, your attacker suffers 2d6 slashing harm.
6. Eruption Pulse: Your Magma Pulse's fire damage increases to 1d8, and whenever you score a critical hit with bludgeoning damage, all foes adjacent to you suffer 1d6 fire harm.

7. Volcanic Command: Once per long rest, when you roll for initiative, choose a point on the ground within 60' to be the centre of a 10' radius persistent zone of molten and unstable earth for the remainder of combat. The zone is difficult terrain and causes 1d4 fire harm to foes.
8. Razorstorm: Your Obsidian Shards harm increases to 4d6, and whenever it triggers you may create a 10' line of shards from you that causes 1d4 slashing harm to foes.

9. Coreheart: You gain 50% resistance to fire damage, are immune to environmental fire damage (including from lava) which allows you to ignore the penalties of hot weather on your journey activities, and you automatically succeed on death saves.

10. Sovereign of the Deepfire: You can now use your Volcanic Command twice between long rests, and its radius increases to 15', its harm increases to 1d8, and while standing inside it, you have 50% resistance to all damage except for psychic, your damaging melee attacks deal +1d8 fire damage, and you cannot be moved against your will.
